Generated using NovelAI. If you want more of my gens, see pixiv.net/en/users/117829783

Updated
- 8/31/2026
- The Slowbro image had an incorrect version of Lass. I originally tried to turn the sprite into a character before I remembered that it was just the sprite that the game gave to Lass trainers at the time. Since I was asked, I know "Rapid Thrust" isn't a move. The joke was supposed to be "She said Rapid Thrust as some kind of sex command, but Slowbro had no idea what she wanted, so he just pushed her down and went at it."
-I know Leaf is standing outside of the fence. The positioning wouldn't be impossible in-game, since there's just a white fence between the Poke Mart and the route outside of Cerulean.
- Added some corrections to older pics just to be a little bit more accurate. Poke Dolls can't be obtained that early, nor can Ultra Balls. Changed them to Potions (or the AI's best guess at them) and more Poke Balls.
- I know the font and text boxes keep changing. I spend multiple hours on each individual image because of little nitpicks that I have with this stuff. Sometimes the AI just outright refuses to do what it's told, so I go with what looks the best for what I have.
- Leaf's hold on Bug Catcher's money looked weird. Gave her a better grip.

- 9/3/2026
- Added a new image about starting Leaf's journey before she chooses her Pokemon.
- Added 2 Nugget Bridge battles. Against that Lass, Leaf didn't even have to do anything? I'm not fully satisfied with the 2nd male trainer's image. I'll think up a better one, and it will be added later when I have a better idea than "show her tits again."
- Added 2 more Nugget Bridge "battles"! Leaf is actually tired? Too bad that Team Rocket doesn't care!

- 9/5/2026
- Victory! Pikachu defeated Ekans! Nugget Bridge has been conquered!
- Meet Bill! Leaf sure doesn't want to!
- Leaf meets a very interesting Lass that unknowingly helps her get a ticket for the S.S. Anne cruise!
- That Lass gets (gives?) some ass!
- When trying to get back a stolen TM from Team Rocket, Leaf is in for a massive surprise!

- 9/10/2026
- Generated some "intro" pages for new locations that Leaf reaches, so far it's Cerulean and Vermilion. I don't know if I'll do this for every single one yet.
- A very passionate "battle" with Drowzee, complete with commentary from Leaf's team!
- Leaf is on the way to Vermilion City! What will she see along the way?
- Will she even survive the walk?!
- I planned on having a battle scene, but I just couldn't generate anything I was satisfied with. I'll keep trying and possibly update this with an actual battle. Since you're here to fap, I doubt you care if there's a multi-page fight scene.
